name: Defensive Duelist
description: When you are wielding a finesse weapon with which you are proficient and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your AC for that attack. If the attack then misses, you may attack the creature with your weapon as part of the same reaction.
